qualification.details: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Optics, Photonics, Instrumentation Engineering, data sciences or a related field. Deep foundational knowledge in RF signal processing, electro-optics, and microwave photonics concepts. Extensive hands-on benchtop experience in designing, assembling, and testing high-speed analog optical links. Demonstrated proficiency in integrating and aligning discrete and integrated optoelectronic hardware, including narrow-linewidth lasers, electro-optic modulators, and high-power photodiodes. Proven ability to perform end-to-end optical and RF system characterization, including key metrics such as link gain, noise figure, spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR), phase noise, and frequency response. Expert operator of high-frequency laboratory instrumentation, such as Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), Optical Spectrum Analyzers (OSAs), RF Spectrum Analyzers, and high-bandwidth oscilloscopes. Familiarity with automated test environments and instrumentation control (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, PyVISA).

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Research Associate II Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Research Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIT Madras Research Associate - II recruitment is 27th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate - II post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate - II post in the Indian Institute of Technology Madras.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate - II position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Optics, Photonics, Instrumentation Engineering, data sciences, or a related field to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate - II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs 61,000 per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IIT Madras Research Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test or interview, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a link to the PDF is provided.

faq.question: Q9. What are the key skills and experience required for this role?
faq.answer: The role requires deep foundational knowledge in RF signal processing, electro-optics, microwave photonics, hands-on experience in optical link design, integration of optoelectronic hardware, system characterization, and proficiency with laboratory instrumentation.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Tamil Nadu apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any geographical restrictions for applicants, but it is always best to check the official notification for any such details.
